headline: Luka Dončić Hands Out 11 Turnovers
subhead: MONSTARS ☄️ took the night 7-4 behind Tyler Herro's 34, while Thug Life watched Toumani Camara score 19 from the bench.

zingers.line: Luka Dončić gift-wrapped 11 turnovers on 8 for 21 shooting, and Acinonyx tied the night 5-5 with Zero Fox Given.
Thug Life benched Toumani Camara's 19 points and 5 threes while starting Mikal Bridges, who shot 0 for 8.
Brandon Miller shot 2 for 14, 1 for 11 from three, and Suggs to be you dropped the night 7-4.
White Mambas got waxed 9-2 on the night by Nova Knicks while Desmond Bane shot 2 for 11.
Domantas Sabonis posted 27, 19 and 10, and Gopher Gold still lost the night 9-2 to BrookynDynasty.
Anthony Edwards jacked up 23 shots and made 5, and BrookynDynasty still won the night 9-2 by accident.
Adam Silver Dez Nuts bricked the whole day, slid three power spots, and lost the night 6-5 to theInfamous.

night: Domantas Sabonis put up 27 points, 19 rebounds and 10 assists on 10 for 13 shooting for Gopher Gold, the best line of the night.
Luka Dončić committed 11 turnovers on 8 for 21 shooting for Acinonyx, the worst brick of the night, and Acinonyx only tied Zero Fox Given.
Thug Life left Toumani Camara on the bench for 19 points and 5 threes while Mikal Bridges started and shot 0 for 8.
Paul Reed posted 19 points and 11 rebounds on 8 for 11 shooting, and not one of the twelve teams in this league owns him.
Nova Knicks flattened White Mambas 9-2 on the night while Desmond Bane shot 2 for 11.
